title: Crispy Roasted Cabbage Steaks with Savory Crumb ('Dirt Cabbage')
originalTitle: Crispy Roasted Cabbage Steaks with Savory Crumb ('Dirt Cabbage')
ingredients: 1 medium green or savoy cabbage, cut into 1-inch wedges or steaks (core intact)
2 tbsp olive oil + 2 tbsp melted butter

Savory 'Dirt' Crumb: 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs, 1/4 cup grated Parmigiano-Reggiano, 2 tbsp toasted sesame seeds, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika, finely chopped nori or parsley
Creamy garlic yogurt or Caesar/tahini ranch drizzle
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Brush the cabbage wedges generously with olive oil and melted butter, season with salt and pepper, and roast on a preheated sheet pan for 25–30 minutes (flipping halfway) until edges are deeply charred and caramelized.

Meanwhile, toast the panko breadcrumbs, sesame seeds, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika in a dry skillet until nutty and golden brown; toss with grated Parmesan and herbs to make the savory 'dirt' crumble.
Spread a swoosh of garlic yogurt or Caesar dressing on a platter, arrange the charred cabbage steaks on top, and blanket generously with the crunchy savory crumb.
